Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code \ Anthropic

claude-opus-4 and Sonnet 4 are hybrid models offering two modes: near-instant responses and extended thinking for deeper reasoning. The Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise Claude plans include both models and extended thinking, with Sonnet 4 also available to free users. Both models are available on the Anthropic API, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud's Vertex AI.
Pricing remains consistent with previous Opus and Sonnet models: Opus 4 at $15/$75 per million tokens (input/output) and Sonnet 4 at $3/$15.

Argues that HTML is often a better output format than Markdown for Claude Code artifacts because it supports richer layout, clearer visual structure, easier sharing, and lightweight interactivity.

Frames HTML artifacts as a way to stay more "in the loop" with Claude when reviewing plans, specs, explainers, and other long-form agent output.
Using Claude Code: The unreasonable effectiveness of HTML

Reasons given: higher information density, better readability for long docs, easier browser-based sharing, two-way interactions, and stronger data ingestion from local files, MCPs, browser context, and git history.
